a.lede: Some saw Huang’s resignation as an opportunity for culture change at the chip giant. “If Jensen comes back, I’m not doing any HR trainings ever again,” one employee said.
a.title: Inside Nvidia, Not Everyone Is Celebrating Jensen Huang’s Return

b.lede: The reinstated Nvidia CEO acknowledged violating the company’s code of conduct and said he had made some “very serious personal mistakes.”
b.title: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Employees in First All-Hands Since His Return
